title: Drop Founders’ Relief
name: Drop Founders’ Relief
headline: Drop Founders’ Relief. Raises £0.3bn in 2029-30.
description: From April 2027 founders and early investors in fast-growing companies pay 10% capital gains tax on up to £10 million of gains. Switch this on to drop the relief.

baselinePolicy.text: Founders’ Relief, a 10% capital gains tax rate with a £10 million lifetime limit, applies from 6 April 2027 (Table 6.1 line 26).

source.quote: This measure introduces a 10% Capital Gains Tax (CGT) rate for qualifying disposals by founders or early investors of high-growth, innovative companies, subject to a £10 million lifetime limit.

alreadyIncludes: Founders’ Relief, a 10% capital gains tax rate with a £10 million lifetime limit, applies from 6 April 2027 (Table 6.1 line 26).

lines.title: Founders' Relief: Introduce a new CGT relief for qualifying founders of high-growth, innovative companies from 6 April 2027

rawSource.note: Reversal: the Treasury’s costing with its sign reversed (positive scorecard values reduce borrowing; here receipts positive means more revenue).

caveats: The Treasury’s costing is on the OBR October 2026 forecast, the baseline used here. Effects before the start year are not applied: 2026-27 falls before any Budget of yours.

considerations.text: The Treasury’s scorecard figure is the certified direct costing for the measure, including the behavioural response the Treasury and OBR agreed; the Budget 2026 policy costings document gives the method.
